sections.heading: Who can apply
sections.html:
If you are interested in applying for Fall 2026–27 Seedlings, Little Seedlings, or Acorns, please review the application process below.

  • Seedlings is for ages 3–6. Children must be 3 years old by Sept. 1, 2026.
  • Little Seedlings is for ages 2–3. Children must be 2 years old by Sept. 1, 2026.
  • Acorns is for ages 3–4. Children must be 3 years old by Sept. 1, 2026.

Children under these ages may be considered at the admission team’s discretion.

sections.heading: Seedlings, Little Seedlings, and Acorns 3-step application process
sections.intro: We’ve designed the application process to ensure your family and Sunflower are a good fit for each other. Applicants for Seedlings, Little Seedlings, and Acorns must complete three steps (in order):

items.title: Attend an Introduction to Early Childhood Programs Meeting
items.html:
In this meeting, you’ll learn about Sunflower’s educational philosophy and tour our indoor and outdoor classroom spaces. This meeting is for adults and babies in arms only. No older children, please.

Sign up for an Introduction to Early Childhood Programs Meeting

items.title: Attend a Visiting Day with your child
items.html:
Prospective children and their parents must attend the program as visitors for at least one day. This visit is important, as it will determine if the program meets everyone’s needs. The visitor fee is $40 per visit. Call 561 501-6615 to schedule.

Sign up for a Sunflower visit

items.title: Complete the application and pay the Application Fee
items.html:
The online application form is available to fill out after attending the Intro Meeting and attending a visiting day with your child. Submitting an application does not ensure enrollment. An Application Fee, which covers the administrative costs of processing your application, is $50 per child and is non-refundable.

I’m ready to apply!

sections.heading: Acceptance and enrollment: Fall 2026
sections.html:
Sunflower will notify families of acceptance, class placement and financial aid decisions (if requested) by March 2, 2026. Acceptance into the program is determined by the admissions team and is based on space availability.

To complete enrollment, families must accept their offered placement by submitting enrollment forms and paying the $200 family enrollment fee by the deadline stated in their enrollment offer.

Families who apply for need-based financial aid will receive a separate notification about the status of their financial aid application.

sections.heading: Step Up For Students approved provider
sections.html: Great news! Sunflower has been approved as a Home Education Instructional Program Provider through Step Up For Students. This designation means that families participating in Florida’s Step Up Scholarship Program can now access Sunflower’s educational offerings as an approved provider.

sections.heading: Seedlings
sections.intro: *Seedlings is for ages 3–6. Children must be 3 years old by Sept. 1, 2026. Children under this age may be considered at the admission team’s discretion.

items.title: About Seedlings
items.html: Seedlings preschool is a play-based early childhood program that nurtures imagination, science and nature exploration, arts expression and literacy, and gives children and parents tools for empowered communication and peaceful problem-solving skills.

items.title: Sunflower parent involvement information
items.html: Parents play an important role at Sunflower. Helping during the Seedlings day gives you a chance to see your child in action, be there for all of the children, and gain a deeper understanding of our philosophy through real hands-on experience. Your involvement gives you the opportunity to get to know all the children, learn from the teachers, and make connections with other parent helpers. An adult from each family is encouraged to participate in the program as a parent helper. All parent helpers are background screened, CPR certified, and are required to take the Parenting Safe Children workshop.

items.title: Sibling discount
items.html: We offer a 10% sibling tuition discount to families enrolling more than one child in Little Seedlings, Seedlings, and/or Acorns. The discount is applied to the second child’s tuition or the lesser tuition amount.

items.title: Financial aid
items.html: Families interested in applying for financial aid for Seedlings should indicate this on their Fall 2026 application. A link to download the Financial Aid Form is included in the program application. Awards are based on financial need and available funds. Determinations will be made within 2–3 weeks of submission.

sections.heading: Little Seedlings
sections.intro: *Little Seedlings is for ages 2–3. Children must be 2 years old by Sept. 1, 2026. Children under this age may be considered at the admission team’s discretion.

items.title: About Little Seedlings
items.html: Little Seedlings is a first taste of social and experiential learning for two- to three-year-olds. In this transitional program, which many families enjoy before the full Seedlings preschool experience, both children and parents have opportunities to practice creative problem solving, conflict resolution, communication, empathy and respect for others. Parents are required to attend with their child for the first six weeks of the year. Each class will include parent participation and ongoing mentoring and support.

items.title: Sunflower parent community involvement information
items.html: Parents play an important role at Sunflower. Helping during the Little Seedlings day gives you a chance to see your child in action, be there for all of the children, and gain a deeper understanding of our philosophy through real hands-on experience. Your involvement gives you the opportunity to get to know all the children, learn from the teachers, and make connections with other parent helpers. An adult from each family is required to participate in the program as a parent helper two to three times during each month. All parent helpers are background screened, CPR certified, and are required to take the Parenting Safe Children workshop.

items.title: Sibling discount
items.html: We offer a 10% sibling tuition discount to families enrolling more than one child in Little Seedlings, Seedlings, and/or Acorns. The discount is applied to the second child’s tuition or the lesser tuition amount.

items.title: Financial aid
items.html: Families interested in applying for financial aid for Little Seedlings should indicate this on their Fall 2026 application. A link to download the Financial Aid Form is included in the program application. Awards are based on a family’s financial need and available funds. Determinations will be made within 2–3 weeks of submission.

sections.heading: Sunflower Acorns
sections.intro: *Sunflower Acorns is for ages 3–4. Children must be 3 years old by Sept. 1, 2026. Children under this age may be considered at the admission team’s discretion.

items.title: About Sunflower Acorns
items.html: Sunflower Acorns is a Play, Nature, and Arts based early childhood program that nurtures imagination, science and nature exploration, and arts expression, and empowers children and parents with tools for communication and peaceful problem-solving skills.

items.title: Sunflower parent community involvement information
items.html: Parents play an important role at Sunflower. Helping during the Acorns day gives you a chance to see your child in action, be there for all of the children, and gain a deeper understanding of our philosophy through real hands-on experience. Your involvement gives you the opportunity to get to know all the children, learn from the teachers, and make connections with other parent helpers. An adult from each family is required to participate in the program as a parent helper a few times during each six-week session. All parent helpers are background screened, CPR certified, and are required to take the Parenting Safe Children workshop.

items.title: Sibling discount

items.title: Financial aid
items.html: Families interested in applying for financial aid for Acorns should indicate this on their Fall 2026 application. A link to download the Financial Aid Form is included in the program application. Awards are based on a family’s financial need and available funds. Determinations will be made within 2–3 weeks of submission.

sections.heading: Acorns class schedule 2026/27
sections.intro: Class schedule 2026/27 (week of Sept. 9 – week of April 16), 24-week program. Sunflower Acorns runs for 24 weeks, divided into four six-week sessions. Acorns meets on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday afternoons from 1:15 pm to 4:15 pm. Snack is included each day. *Dates may be subject to change.
